steps.en: Install the library and start a graph database
steps.zh: 装好库，起一个图数据库
steps.code: pip install graphiti-core · docker compose up

steps.en: Connect to the database, with an LLM key in the environment
steps.zh: 连上数据库，环境里放好 LLM 密钥

steps.en: Feed each new message or JSON record in as an episode
steps.zh: 每来一条消息或 JSON 记录，就作为一个 episode 喂进去

steps.en: An LLM extracts entities and facts and merges them with known ones
steps.zh: 用 LLM 抽出实体和事实，与已有的合并去重

steps.en: Older facts the new one contradicts get an end date, not deleted
steps.zh: 被新事实推翻的旧事实打上失效时间，不删除

steps.en: Before the agent answers, search the graph
steps.zh: 智能体回答前，先查一下图

steps.en: Returns matching facts via embeddings, keywords and graph links
steps.zh: 综合语义、关键词和图上关系，返回相关事实

value.en: The agent answers from what is true now, and can still trace when and from which message each fact came
value.zh: 智能体按“现在为真”的事实回答，还能追溯每条事实何时成立、出自哪条消息

sources: https://github.com/getzep/graphiti README (Installation: pip install graphiti-core; Running with Docker Compose: docker compose up; Why Graphiti: facts invalidated not deleted, hybrid semantic + BM25 + graph traversal)
